Existing Google Groups can have an additional label with a key of `cloudidentity.googleapis.com/groups.security` and an empty value added to them. **This is an immutable change and the security label cannot be removed once added.** Dynamic groups have a label with a key of `cloudidentity.googleapis.com/groups.dynamic`. The value for `member.customer_id` only supports `groupCustomerId()` currently which means the customer id of the group will be used for restriction.
